research_question: Do three static obstacle-distance features improve mean food score relative to the original 11 features?
hypothesis: Model B may have a higher mean score, but benefit is not assumed. Report all three paired training-seed differences, including null or negative results.
primary_outcome: Mean food items per greedy evaluation episode; aggregate as the mean of three independent training-seed means.
training_seed_schedule: 200000 + training_seed * 1000 + zero_based_episode_index; shared within each A/B pair
distance_definition: Consecutive free cells before current wall/body; tail occupied. Divide by max(board_width, board_height)-1.

analysis.comparison: B minus A paired by training seed
analysis.checkpoint_selection: final only; no seed or checkpoint selection
